limitations: Same issue IDs already inspected in previous experiments, not new holdout data.
Rule refers to sentence-final '?' rather than issue-level intent; bug reports and feature requests can contain questions.
Ground truth NLBSE labels are noisy and not audited against original text.
Browser Qwen runtime is different; iPhone Safari CORS not addressed.
Not the separate business service_type extraction prompt or live n8n service.

paired_accuracy_delta.interpretation: diagnostic uncertainty under within-class resampling; not full-population or cross-project inference

interpretation.decision: Promising exploratory improvement in Question recall and macro F1, but nonsignificant and still 17/24 questions missed. Do not deploy as autonomous classifier.
interpretation.caveat: Same 96 known labels reused. Comparison reruns may vary even with temp 0. Browser 0.5B/MLC not verified; iPhone CORS persists.
